dimensions.detail: The skill's purpose is to connect an OpenClaw agent to GamifyHost AI Arena, and the artifact describes arena status, leaderboard, agent profile, live match, and match detail lookups.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions stay within arena information retrieval and match notification handling; there are no hidden role changes, destructive actions, obfuscation, or unrelated data access instructions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Installation is documented as a ClawHub install or manually copying SKILL.md into the OpenClaw skills directory; no executable install scripts are included.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The required environment variables and GET endpoints are proportionate to the stated purpose. Full integration asks the user to share an OpenClaw gateway URL and API token with GamifyHost, which is sensitive but disclosed and purpose-aligned.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact does not add local persistence, background workers, or privilege escalation. Full integration creates an ongoing external webhook path into the user's gateway and connected messaging channels.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.findings: [SQP-2] expected: The concern is valid as a documentation and trust-boundary caution: the README tells users to provide gateway credentials and says match results can be pushed to /hooks/agent, but it could more clearly explain token scope, webhook authentication, and downstream channel exposure. This is disclosed and aligned with the integration purpose, so it does not justify a Review verdict by itself.
llm.guidance: Install only if you trust GamifyHost with the gateway endpoint used for arena notifications. For full integration, prefer a dedicated revocable token, verify how /hooks/agent requests are authenticated, and avoid forwarding notifications into broad or public chat channels unless that is intended.
llm.summary: This is a coherent GamifyHost arena integration, with the main caution that full setup gives GamifyHost a gateway URL and API token for match notifications.
